Know what sits outside the subscription

Connections, usage and extra help.

WhatsApp Business

Essentials: optional US$19/month connection. The connection is included in Core, Build and Scale.

Billable messages are separate on every plan. An eligible account, number and permissions are required.

Usage and support

Email delivery, billable WhatsApp messages, phone usage and premium workflow actions are charged separately. Voice AI minutes do not include phone-system charges.

Extra help costs US$250 per 5-hour block. Agree the scope and block terms before work begins.

How do AI spending controls work?

Monthly AI spending limits and blocking can be configured per account. We will agree and check your settings before activation. Dollar spending limits are separate from your included response and minute allowances.

What does the Essentials trial include?

A free 7-day trial of Essentials. Customer-facing AI and the WhatsApp add-on are not included in that subscription. Trial registration, card requirements and what happens after day seven will be clearly shown before signup opens.

Which plan includes a customer-facing AI assistant?

Build and Scale include initial chatbot setup on one agreed channel, using your approved knowledge to answer questions and capture details. Core provides tools for your team. Essentials includes the listed AI builders.

Can I set things up myself?

Yes. Configure supported tools yourself or use the guided setup within your first-month allowance. Extra channels, integrations, data cleanup and bespoke workflows need an agreed scope.
